author: Alyson Wyper
content: We have used USB several times for different events - hiring a variety of bouncy castles and games equipment. They are always extremely accommodating and a friendly service. Punctual for drop off and collection. Great value for money. The inflatables are great - always a huge hit and lots of fun!! They go over and above too - recently I hired a bouncy castle and had misjudged the height of the ceiling (oops - my fault!). USB happily went out their way to get us a different bouncy castle that suited in time for our event starting which was so so appreciated. Great company, can highly recommend and we look forward to continuing to use them in the future! 😃
